messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "use within 8 weeks of opening bottle"
set: ["use within 8 weeks of opening bottle", "use within 90 days of opening bottle", "use all ampules within 3 months after opening foil pouch", "94% after 8 weeks", "discard unused liquid in trash after 60 days of opening bottle", "most ulcers heal within 4 weeks of treatment", "get new bottle if not taken within 60 minutes of mixing", "shake the bottle before each use", "use the dropper supplied with the bottle", "use the mixture within 15 minutes", "throw away any unused oral solution 20 days after first opening the bottle", "throw away any unused concentrated solution 90 days after first opening the bottle", "use the remaining half within 28 days", "do not use within 14 days before MAO inhibitor use", "target stop date should be set within first 2 weeks of treatment", "given for up to 8 weeks while esophagus heals"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
